title: Toyota '96 HDJ80 - Cummins 6BT conversion
transmission: H151F manual (retained, converted from donor's automatic Allison flywheel/bellhousing)
ai_summary: A 1996 HDJ80 owner is swapping in a Cummins 6BT 5.9L sourced from a 1998 Thomas school bus, targeting roughly 300 hp with better reliability than the factory 1HD-T. The bus engine came with an automatic Allison bellhousing/flywheel, so it had to be converted to mate with the Toyota manual gearbox.

complications.detail: Cummins block's factory engine mounts collide with the 80-series firewall, requiring cutting/adapting to a flanged mounting style
Bus-sourced 6BT had an automatic (Allison) flywheel/bellhousing that had to be swapped for manual components
Installed a 450x300x76mm aftermarket intercooler and dual 12-inch electric fans
Integrating factory A/C onto the 6BT was reported as the most difficult retrofit aspect
